title: Trainer 100 ~100 Things I Want to Do with Trainer~

text_block_list.name: Kiseki?
text_block_list.text:
...*huff*, *pant*, *huff*...
Are you okay? Can you still run?
choice_data_list: *pant*, *gasp*... S-Somehow...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki?
text_block_list.text:
Thank goodness... We need to keep moving!
Otherwise, those things will—

text_block_list.name: Undead
text_block_list.text: Ughhh... GRAAAAAHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki?
text_block_list.text:
—! Get up!!
Hurry!

Year 20XX. Early summer. One sunny morning.
The despair began.

In under a month, humanity was overrun by the dead devouring all living beings—
the ZBSS... stripping away their peaceful everyday lives.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki?
text_block_list.text:
...That should do for a barricade!
The ZBSS shouldn't be able to break in for a while!
choice_data_list: ...A while, huh... If it lasts half a day, we're lucky.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki?
text_block_list.text:
....... There was a clothing store over that way.
Since it's an emergency, I'll go grab us a change of clothes!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki?
text_block_list.text:
Ta-daaa! How's this?
Do I look totally badass?
choice_data_list: ...In a life-or-death situation, how could you possibly...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki?
text_block_list.text: —That is precisely why.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki?
text_block_list.text:
This looks just like a suit my favorite character wore.
That's why I picked it.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki?
text_block_list.text: I'm not letting those things choose what I'm wearing when I die.
choice_data_list: ......You really are something else...
......You really are something else...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki?
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, it's my first time trying it, but... cosplay is so much fun!
I know! Why don't you join in? I'll pick an outfit out for you!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki?
text_block_list.text:
...Nice! It looks amazing on you!
I knew suits looked way more dapper on adults!
choice_data_list: I-I'd never wear something this flashy to work, though...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki?
text_block_list.text:
Really? Then from now on,
you should totally show up to the office like that!
choice_data_list: In a purple floral suit?! My coworkers would freak out!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki?
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Well then, what should we try next?
Maybe a wizard or something fantasy-themed? Want to give it a shot?!

...To me, that time was a gem of a moment.
It was the final twenty-five minutes where I could forget everything and laugh alongside him.

...To me, that time was a gem of a moment.
It was the final twenty-five minutes where I could forget everything and laugh alongside her.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki?
text_block_list.text:
No... No, NO!!!!
Not like this... Please, no...!
choice_data_list: Don't cry! You don't have to cry! Just live!
Don't cry! You don't have to cry! Just live!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki?
text_block_list.text:
B-But you promised! You said we'd go to the exhibition again!
We promised we'd take photos with Ushippy and the others... You promised...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki?
text_block_list.text:
...Don't leave me behind...! Please...!
Take me with you...!
choice_data_list: —Keep your eyes forward and press on, Joanna.
—Keep your eyes forward and press on, Joanna.

text_block_list.name: Joanna
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaaagh...! ...Uuuugh... *sniff*...
............—I'll never forgive them.

text_block_list.name: Joanna
text_block_list.text:
...I'll end it all. For the sake of the next era.
Just watch me. That's how I'm going to survive—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —S-So, what did you think???!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry for shouting...! Um, well...
I'm pretty proud of it myself, but... h-how was it?

One day during the summer training camp. I tap my tablet to close
the manuscript Kiseki handed me. My thoughts on her work, titled "I'm the Last One"—
choice_data_list: It was amazing! Seriously incredible!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
HECK YEAAAH!! Woohoo!!
...Ah!

It delivered on everything a classic panic horror should—a true masterpiece.
The vivid depictions of zombies and charming characters completely drew me in, but above all—
choice_data_list: That department store scene midway through? I loved it!

text_block_list.text:
I tell her that because of how relentless the tension was up to that point,
the cheerful banter between the characters brought a genuine smile to my face.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~! That makes me so happy!
...Oh gosh, I can't stop grinning!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You're so right, though! The scene where Joanna and the others hold
a cosplay contest in the department store was super popular with everyone else too!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it... hehe.
Did you notice anything?

Hearing that, a thought crosses my mind regarding something that felt familiar.
Could the cosplay contest scene be...
choice_data_list: Based on what we did together?
Based on what we did together?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: YES!!! It actually is!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
When I was storyboarding, I just went, "This is it!!"
Once I put it in, it ended up becoming one of my favorite scenes too!
choice_data_list: I see! That explains the other scenes—

text_block_list.text:
Taking photos with mascots, looking at original manga manuscripts...
It makes sense that several scenes mirrored our experiences from that day, but—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Huh? The other scenes too?
No, the only thing I referenced was the cosplay...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Wait? Actually, you're right. Going around the art exhibition together
and everything... That really was just straight from our time together, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
choice_data_list: Whoa! Wh-What's wrong?
Whoa! Wh-What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Um, well, can I please take this back for a second?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: E-Excuse me!
choice_data_list: Ah, Kiseki?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
........................Yup. Uh-huh.
There's... absolutely no denying it now.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha, oh man.
My face is burning up.

Later that night. Kiseki called me out to the beach,
and as soon as I arrived, she handed me a present.
choice_data_list: Um, what's this...?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
A thank-you gift. It's a collection of manga I recommend...
I picked a wide variety of genres, so I'm sure you'll find something you like!
choice_data_list: Thank you! But... what are you thanking me for?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Well, um... I showed you that manga earlier today, right?
It's for inspiring me to draw it in the first place...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
To be honest... when I was drawing the storyboards, the ideas just kept flowing!
I felt confident I could make it great, but that's only because—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The time I spent with you, Trainer,
was just so, so much fun.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...When I read it back, it was ridiculously obvious. Even in parts I didn't realize,
it was packed with everything from the manga exhibition we went to.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...So of course it turned out great!
After all—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I poured all the moments that brought me joy straight into my work.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Every single panel was overflowing with the feeling of,
"I had so much fun hanging out with Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
So... hehe.
Thank you... for that.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: For giving me such an irreplaceable experience.
choice_data_list: ...I see. I'm really glad I could help!

text_block_list.text:
Hearing Kiseki speak so sincerely fills me with warmth.
All we did was spend time together, but it seems it became fuel for her creative spark.
choice_data_list: So, what kind of experience should we share next?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
choice_data_list: If it's for your manga, I'm happy to help anytime!
If it's for your manga, I'm happy to help anytime!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
............Ahaha.
You really are something else, Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You said it, okay? No taking it back!
If you're really fine with it, I'm dragging you along again!
choice_data_list: Yeah, bring it on!
Yeah, bring it on!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hehe... That smile of yours looks like a full double-page spread.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I really can't compete with that.
